nom: Kopari Beauty Niacinamide & Caffeine Eye Bright Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one describing it as dry and sensitive, report the cream is hydrating under the eyes and helps makeup crack and crease less, though one dry-skin reviewer found it a bit drying with regular use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report the cream absorbs well and has a pleasant cooling effect, but others (unspecified skin type) report the embedded glitter irritates and itches the eyes.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention age (mid-60s, crow's feet, fine lines) report visible smoothing of lines and reduced puffiness, with one such reviewer also noting the product feels drying.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly softer fine lines and crow's feet, and smoother skin over time; results are generally described as gradual rather than immediate.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers find the cream hydrating and say it prevents makeup from creasing, but two mention it leaves the under-eye area feeling dry, especially with frequent use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product stings, particularly if it gets into the eye, though she still preferred it over a competitor despite the stinging.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers describe the product as gentle, with no breakouts or rashes and a soothing, non-tight feel after absorption.
concerns.spots: No reviewers discuss spots or hyperpigmentation specifically; dark circles are addressed under aging/dehydration-type complaints rather than spots.
concerns.blemishes: No reviewers report breakouts caused by the product; one explicitly notes no breakouts or rash occurred.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewers discuss oiliness or oil control; this is not a concern addressed by the review set.
